description: (kinker-65-87 pands 1-2, Kinkerstraat 65 and 67, 1893): plain red-brown brick without speklagen or painted courses, flat heads, iron anchors, 4 upper storeys, a stepped gable with one attic light under a relieving arch. A library type of its own because no other type has it: plain-brick has no gable crown, and the gabled types (neo-renaissance, brick-arched) carry speklagen or painted courses that a placement cannot remove (speklagen needs bands speklagen; bandLines needs bands painted).

step-2.note: 65: two steps a side, narrow top

rhythm.roofline: stepped gable with one attic light
schemaLimits: relieving arch over the attic light

notes: Palette: mean of palette-from-strip walls #714a2d and #7e5e40 (sunlit 2024-11-29).

Promoted to the Oud-West library 2026-10-14 (lane kinker-colour-fidelity) from kinker-65-87 inline; the first palette is the inline one, so placements resolve unchanged. Per-pand palettes are palette-from-strip medians.
